data.name: VeilStalker
data.detailed_description:
VeilStalker

You are a modern-day hunter. While hunting in the forest you come upon an old Cold war era bunker. Exploring it, you find an intact portal, as you turn the power on, the portal suddenly opens up, dragging you in. Emerging on the other side, you find yourself stranded in a brutal fantasy world full of magic, monsters, and danger.

Now you must survive — using the modern weapons you brought from Earth against mythical horrors that have never faced modern firepower before.

A Unique Co-op & Solo Fantasy Survival Shooter

VeilStalker is a co-op and solo survival game that blends the tension and creativity of Sons of the Forest and Valheim with satisfying modern gunplay in a dangerous high-fantasy world.

Hunt. Build. Salvage. Survive. Alone or Together.

Key Features

  • Modern Weapons vs Fantasy — Take down goblins with MP5s, blast dragons with RPGs, and stop giants with tank mines. Ammo is scarce, forcing smart usage and tactical combat.

  • Weapon Salvage & Creation — Scavenge parts from the modern world and fantasy ruins to repair, modify, and craft new weapons. Find classic blades, magical artifacts, enchanted ammunition, and hybrid gun-magic creations.

  • Deep Base Building — Construct hidden outposts, fortifications, and massive strongholds. Set up defensive positions with machine gun nests, claymores, and tank traps to survive night raids and monster hordes.

  • Vast Procedural Open World — Explore dense forests, ancient ruins, mysterious dungeons, towering spires, and deadly wildlands.

  • Dynamic Day/Night & Weather System — Time of day and changing weather affect enemy behavior, visibility, and survival difficulty.

  • Hunt or Be Hunted — Face deadly monsters, powerful bosses, and overwhelming hordes in a world where danger is everywhere.

  • Solo or Co-op — Fully playable solo or with friends. Team up in co-op to explore, build, and take down epic bosses together.

  • Exploration & Progression — Loot ancient ruins for rare materials, magical items, and powerful artifacts while mastering the balance between gunpowder and magic.

  • You're not alone — As you explore more and more of this world you realize you're not first one to arrive. How many and for how long this cold war secret project was running is still to be determined.

  • A battle between good & evil — It is clear that the good people of this world are in dire straits, facing overwhelming darkness. This where you come in, tipping the scales and letting the bad guys know what it feels to be at the end of a high powered sniper rifle.

Every bullet counts. Every base must be defended. From tense solo scavenging runs to massive co-op battles against dragons and goblin hordes — VeilStalker delivers intense, emergent procedural survival gameplay where modern tactics meet high fantasy.

data.short_description: A solo and co-op fantasy survival game where you as modern hunter is trapped in a brutal magical realm. Build bases, scavenge scarce ammunition, hunt legendary creatures, and survive against giant monsters, haunting undead and unforgiving environments.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Phenom X3 8650
  • Graphics: Nvidia 1080GTX
